_doc: Zack-D-style prototype 1 (AI stills). Fixed style + character sheet + seeds -> repeatable. {BOY}/{MAN}/{SET} are expanded by gen.py. Generated by .github/workflows/zack-images.yml (SDXL base 1.0 + SDXL-Lightning 4-step UNet, both CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M).
style: 3d animated feature film still, pixar style cgi render, stylized cartoon characters with big expressive eyes, soft global illumination, subsurface scattering, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colors, shallow depth of field, highly detailed, 8k

chars.BOY: a cute 10 year old boy with dark curly hair, grey flat wool cap, brown wool coat, red knitted scarf
chars.MAN: a burly dock worker with a thick black mustache, grey flat cap, white shirt with rolled sleeves, brown suspenders
chars.SET: 1919 Boston harbor street, red brick warehouses, steel elevated railway on riveted girders, cold winter day
